generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The bidder must compulsorily furnish valid caste and domicile certificate for mentioned reserved works above.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The intending bidder should furnish the copy of the registration certificate issued by KPWD IV and above for Civil contractor.
Tenderer should furnish a copy of the Income Tax Return for the preceding five financial year (2021-22 to 2025-26)
The Tenderer should furnish a valid copy of GST Registration Certificate.
Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate, if the bidder has less than 20 labours he has to submit self-certified labour details failing which which their tenders will be disqualified
The bidder should furnish Annual turn over certificate indicating turnover of past five years with compulsory UDIN Number.

Eligible tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will becalculated as under Assessed available tender capacity AXNX5.00 -BWhere,A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years Updated to 2026-27 price level taking in to account the completed as well as works in progressN Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invitedBValue at 2026-27 price level of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed
Other documents as per notification and bid document

Complete work with all lead and lift and as per the specification and as per instructions of Engineer Incharge of work
